text: Main tradeoff: since there's zero build pipeline today, I'd either load NDK straight from a CDN (jsDelivr/esm.sh, simplest, but resolves deps at runtime on every visit) or prebuild a small bundle locally once (esbuild) and commit the output `.js` as a static asset (faster, pinned, but means running a build step by hand whenever the widget code changes — not on every deploy, just when I edit it).
